title: Video sound effects join the audio API
summary:
Sonilo adds video-timed sound effects, Barbara starts on a Quest Pollen model, and audio and model conversations get several fixes.

Sonilo can generate a separate MP3 sound-effects track timed to a public video URL. Audio request defaults now work across chat completions and model fallbacks without overriding caller settings. Live transcription starts without a client session update, and realtime session events report requestable model names.

New Barbara setups default to `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`. Her model picker now identifies which choices can use Quest Pollen and shows a per-message estimate for GPT-6.1 Sol.

Gemini tool calls can now continue through `/v1/messages` when an Anthropic client replays the conversation. Step 3.7 Flash requests now route to providers serving StepFun rather than receiving MiMo responses.

daily.title: Sound effects for video
daily.text: Give `sonilo/sonilo-1.1-sfx` a public video URL in `reference_video` and a sound prompt to generate a separate MP3 effects track timed to the video. It requires a paid balance and has no fallback. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=sonilo/sonilo-1.1-sfx).

daily.title: Barbara starts on GPT-6.1 Sol
daily.text: New Barbara setups default to `openai/gpt-6.1-sol`, which can use Quest Pollen. The model picker also shows which choices are Quest Pollen-eligible and gives a per-message estimate for GPT-6.1 Sol.
